title: Clear the Play Console blockers: replace rc.2 on Internal testing with 1.0.1, Advertising ID No, keep the 1.0.0 notes
context: After the 1.0.1 upload, App content still needed the Foreground service declaration because Internal testing release 7 (1.0.0-rc.2) is live, plus a new Advertising ID declaration; the Alpha 1.0.1 draft carried the 1.0.0 release notes. The owner answered all three on 2026-10-12.
options: Replace rc.2 on Internal testing with the 1.0.1 bundle
Declare the foreground service with the demo video
option_reasons: Chosen: no live bundle would then request the permission; internal testers lose sync on their Play copy
Not chosen: unverified whether Play stops counting a paused track's bundle
Not chosen: the declaration is what option B set out to avoid
Not chosen: the owner asked Claude to do it
outcome: Owner chose: replace rc.2 with 1.0.1 on Internal testing (Claude prepares the release and stops before Save and publish for the owner's yes); answer No on the Advertising ID declaration and save (done 2026-10-12, Play said Change saved; the Play build's 576-line Android dependency list and 214 Dart packages hold no ad or analytics SDK, and its merged manifest has no AD_ID); keep the 1.0.0 notes on the Alpha 1.0.1 draft. The Internal testing draft (release 2, bundle 12, rc.2 not included, the same en-US notes as Alpha) sits on Preview and confirm with no warnings.
